query: For a 58‑year‑old woman: among female ICU patients aged 53–63 with sepsis, what are the 75th and 90th percentiles of procedures in the first 24 hours? Compare to age‑matched ICU patients and report average ICU LOS and hospital mortality.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY procedure_duration) AS q75, percentile_cont(0.90) within GROUP (ORDER BY procedure_duration) AS q90 FROM procedures_in_first_24_hours WHERE subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM icu_patients); SELECT (SELECT AVG(los) FROM age_matched_icu_patients) AS avg_icu_los, (SELECT AVG(drg_mortality) FROM age_matched_icu_patients) AS avg_hospital_mortality;
